q0_experiment_freeze.note: Freeze is a byte-level audit of EXISTING files; no experiment was re-run, no number was recomputed by training.

q1_withdrawal_W14.claim_withdrawn: speak_smoke_results.json top-k shows the base model cannot produce Chinese
q1_withdrawal_W14.why: Those logits came from a PRE-FIX forward: RoPE used absolute positions under left padding, the additive mask had the wrong broadcast shape, and embedding rows were read from virtual offset 0 instead of the tensor's own data offset. All four are implementation defects, not properties of the weights.
q1_withdrawal_W14.status: WITHDRAWN; the smoke file is retained as evidence of the bug, NOT as a model-capability result
q1_withdrawal_W14.further: The corrected 24-layer run was attempted but the sandbox killed the long command (HTTP 502) at layer 0/18/21 across staged attempts; no complete corrected logits exist. Therefore NO claim is made in either direction.

generation_evidence_from_the_package_its.student_continuation: 城市，有，北京，北京，北京，北京，北京，

verdict_basis: The package's own evidence records repetition loops and semantic breakdown on three Chinese prompts.
All 28 language-side layers are static input-independent mixers: 0 language-side self_attn tensors, 0 N×N score, 0 KV cache. The measured static-kernel ceiling is cos 0.3695.
DC-bias reduces repetition 0.6429 -> 0.2143 but does not restore factual QA behaviour.
181 steps of next-token finetuning made repetition WORSE (+0.0625) despite a lower holdout CE.
not_claimed: No autoregressive generation was re-run in this round (no torch, 2 CPUs, 370 MiB free disk).
This is a verdict on the EXISTING migrated package, not on the original Qwen3-0.6B checkpoint.
